avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces bortezomib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks before bortezomib initiation; consider alternative mood support

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased bleeding risk; bortezomib-induced thrombocytopenia combined with antiplatelet properties
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor CBC closely if patient unwilling to discontinue

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates anticoagulant effects and increases bleeding risk in thrombocytopenic patients
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU/day; monitor for hemorrhage

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance proteasome inhibition effects; theoretical additive neuroprotection
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for increased side effects; inform oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase bortezomib levels slightly
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity; assess necessity with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effect; additive with bortezomib-induced thrombocytopenia
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor platelet counts regularly

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases bortezomib plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely eliminate from diet during treatment; educate on hidden sources (pomelo, tangelo)

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may modestly reduce bortezomib levels
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent intake; no need to eliminate; monitor clinical response

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay bortezomib absorption; optimal dosing on empty or light stomach
caution_foods.action: Administer on empty stomach or with light snack; counsel on timing with meals

monitoring_notes: Monitor CBC closely for thrombocytopenia (primary dose-limiting toxicity) and peripheral neuropathy progression. Assess drug interactions carefully as bortezomib is metabolized hepatically; renal function impacts accumulation. Counsel patients to avoid all grapefruit products and report any bleeding or neurological changes immediately.
